name: Indian Camp Creek
about: Indian Camp Creek drains about 31 square miles, 13% of it in St. Charles County. The land ranges from about 860 feet above sea level at its highest point to about 460 feet at its lowest. Its main streams are Indian Camp Creek and Crow Branch. It includes part of Foristell. Downstream, its water passes through the Lower Big Creek watershed, then flows into the Cuivre River, which empties into the Mississippi River.
